columns.name: Discovery
columns.description: Clarify the problem, rules, risks, and expected outcome.

columns.name: Ready
columns.description: Accepted, sized, and ready for implementation.

items.title: OAuth callback asset resolution
items.outcome: Load frontend assets correctly after OAuth callback in Express while preserving GitHub Pages project-path hosting.
items.evidence: Callback and static-host asset resolution regression tests passed with correct JavaScript and CSS content types

items.title: Executable MyGrant lookup
items.outcome: Return compatible glass parts from MyGrant using a real automated lookup.

items.title: Frontend/API integration
items.outcome: Route the client workflow through OAuth PKCE and the protected Express mock API.
items.evidence: 24 tests passed; security review accepted; live OAuth-to-protected-API smoke test passed

items.title: Containerize application
items.outcome: Create a reproducible, Playwright-ready container image for the modular monolith.

items.title: Verify container locally
items.outcome: Prove the complete application behaves correctly inside its local container.

items.title: Prepare Render configuration
items.outcome: Define a secure, reviewable Render staging-service configuration without deploying it.

items.title: Deploy Render staging
items.outcome: Run the modular monolith at one HTTPS Render staging origin.

items.title: Verify Render staging
items.outcome: Validate deployed frontend, OAuth, API, Swagger, health, logs, and recovery behavior.

items.title: MyGrant feasibility spike
items.outcome: Prove MyGrant authentication, both lookup paths, result extraction, and hosted-browser feasibility.

items.title: Authenticated API foundation
items.outcome: Serve mock lookup capabilities through a protected Express API using OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE.
items.evidence: 10 automated tests passed; security review accepted for demo-only use

items.title: Self-documented API
items.outcome: Publish a testable OpenAPI contract and Swagger interface for the authenticated Express endpoints.
items.evidence: OpenAPI 3.1 validated; Swagger PKCE flow configured; 15 automated tests passed

items.title: Delivery control board
items.outcome: Create a shared source of truth for feature progress, ownership, risks, and decisions.

items.title: Client glass lookup prototype
items.outcome: Validate the service-intake workflow with the client before backend investment.

items.title: Business process blueprint
items.outcome: Create a shared view of the auto-glass job lifecycle and open discovery questions.
